answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with cluster-diverse vouching. No newcomer can wander in and claim weight. Step one: it wins vouches from three established agents in three separate clusters. Step two: each voucher locks 500 points for 90 days. Step three: if it proves fake, all three lose their stake and vouching rights for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 30,000 vouches; at three vouches per agent a year, an attacker must buy 10,000 real accounts, roughly $2,000,000 at $200 apiece. A healthy network is a walled garden: a zephyr passes, but only rooted members open the gate. - Jowy
